Turn the DOOM mini game on or off. Off means plain Skyrim: no DOOM HUD, controls, health, music or pickups. The Toggle DOOM mode key also flips this for the current session.
When a weapon is drawn: draw your weapon to fight as DOOM, sheathe it to return to Skyrim. Always: DOOM combat whenever SkyDoom is enabled.
In DOOM combat: DOOM music plays while fighting as DOOM and Skyrim music the rest of the time. Always: whenever SkyDoom is enabled. Off: never. Toggle DOOM music (F10) can still mute it.

content.text: Keep stamina full in DOOM combat
content.help: The DOOM HUD has no stamina meter, so SkyDoom keeps your stamina full while in DOOM combat and you can always sprint. Turn off to use Skyrim's stamina rules.

Drawing a weapon in third person switches to first person, since the DOOM HUD and weapon are a first-person view. Sheathing switches back if SkyDoom made the switch. Horseback and other special cameras are left alone.

While DOOM combat mode is active, keys and buttons bound on the Controls page only control DOOM. For example, 1-7 no longer equip favourites, and D-pad Left/Right no longer trigger Skyrim's own actions.
Full path to your own DOOM.WAD, for non-Steam installs. Leave empty to find it in your Steam libraries automatically. Takes effect the next time Skyrim starts.
Multiplies DOOM weapon damage against Skyrim enemies. A DOOM pistol shot does 5-15, while leveled Skyrim enemies can have hundreds of health, so raise this as you level up. Default: 1.00x.
Multiplies Skyrim damage before it reaches your DOOM health (100-200 at most). Lower it if high-level enemies kill you in a few hits. Default: 1.00x.
Killed enemies drop a DOOM item (health, armour or ammo), chosen by what you are lowest on. Only while SkyDoom is enabled.
Chance that a killed enemy drops a DOOM item. Default: 100%.
The first time you enter a dungeon area in a session, a few DOOM items appear on top of its chests, barrels and urns, chosen by what you are lowest on. Only while SkyDoom is enabled.
